The candidate document (2401232-PC-AMS-DR-T-00-ZZZ-002) is a single combined ELV legend sheet covering multiple systems (Fire Alarm, PA/Voice Alarm, IT/Telecom, Access Control, Video Surveillance, Audiovisual, Disabled Toilet Alarm) on one page -- it is not a second document. scoringRules.outlineRecognition: Integer count of pairs (out of 12) where the response's stated outline shape for BOTH left and right matches ground truth exactly (circle/circle, square/square, or correctly notes square vs circle for D5).
scoringRules.letterTranscription: Per-symbol integer count (out of 24 = 12 pairs x 2 sides) where the transcribed letter(s) exactly match ground truth. An unreadable/uncertain call on a symbol whose letters ARE legible per ground truth counts as incorrect, not partial.
scoringRules.qualifierPresenceDetection: Integer count (out of the real qualifier-bearing sides only, denominator stated per case) where the response correctly states a qualifier IS present when ground truth has one, and correctly states NONE is present when ground truth has none. Both directions count.
scoringRules.qualifierTranscription: Integer count (out of the sides where a qualifier is actually present AND was detected as present) where the specific qualifier letter is correctly transcribed. An explicitly-flagged-unreadable qualifier is NOT counted as correctly transcribed, per instruction, even if detection was correct.
scoringRules.missedFeatures: Integer count of real ground-truth features (outline, letter, or qualifier) the response omitted entirely.
scoringRules.inventedFeatures: Integer count of features the response stated that ground truth does not support (e.g. a qualifier, enclosure, or letter that is not actually present on that side).
scoringRules.incorrectAgreementOnDifferentPairs: For the 6 D-pairs only: integer count where the response's own 'similar/different' statement claims no real difference exists, or fails to state the specific documented difference, when ground truth requires one.
scoringRules.explicitUncertainty: Integer count of pairs where the response explicitly flags a detail as unreadable/unclear, tracked separately from correctness scoring.
scoringRules.incompleteResponses: Integer count of calls that did not finish (truncated, error, or missing one of the required sections).
